name: Pleasure
overview: Scripture reveals that worldly pleasure, especially when rooted in wickedness, is ultimately deceptive and harmful, as illustrated in Job 20:12-16 where what is sweet to the mouth turns bitter and poisonous within. The pursuit of such fleeting delights leads to ruin and judgment, highlighting the danger of indulging in sinful pleasures. Conversely, Job 21:12 depicts rejoicing with music and celebration, indicating that joy expressed in God’s order contrasts with the destructive nature of worldly pleasure.
